threatFindings.threat: Mechanism: A's 800h trail beats MOVSW teams by changing A's anchor velocity relative to theirs (B081 velocity hypothesis)

recommendation: KT meets the screen bar (ALL +0.0252, threat +0.049 lo>0, no group significantly negative) and is the best domain-1 defense combined with the best general combination; the MOVSW defense and K's searcher gains add without interference. Do NOT promote on this evidence: (1) its two parts each confirmed at only +0.001 (A_t800) and +0.009 (K) pooled, so the expected confirm pooled is about +0.01, below what one confirm resolves at z=2.5; (2) A_t800's confirm nozombie -0.050 would probably fail the nozombie gate (K offsets ~+0.01); (3) its strong screen loss -0.060 is A_t800's known per-cohort pattern. If the coordinator spends one confirmation on a domain-1 candidate, KT is the one to use, and its nozombie group is the decisive check. Otherwise keep A_t800 as an add-on for any future combination that has a nozombie surplus.
